shared_handler_6.note: Same relocated body. This body does not read the item record.

execution_proof: Handler 96504 returns 0 unless the event byte is 1 or 9 and byte 23C3F is <= 8. Admitted calls are 7C5DC(23819, 1). That callee increments 23C3F before its first 15A22D and selects resource index 0x25, 0x26, or 0x27. Bit 0 of 269C4 clear reaches E3924(23C68, word([269CC]+130), 0, 0, 1). 77ACC(23348, 0) clears held item 23C57 and the handler calls 9B8F0(item, 0) only when byte 223D4 is 0; a nonzero 223D4 keeps the item and skips 9B8F0. Nine admitted calls from counter 0 leave 9, and the next call returns 0.
